title: Healthy School Recognized Campus: A Hybrid Type 2 Implementation-Effectiveness Trial
official: Healthy School Recognized Campus: A Hybrid Type 2 Implementation-Effectiveness Trial
summary: Healthy School Recognized Campus is a Texas A\&M AgriLife Extension initiative that supports the delivery of school-based physical activity and nutrition programs for diverse youth across Texas. The purpose of this study is to conduct a type 2 hybrid implementation-effectiveness, cluster dual randomized controlled trial (DRCT) to assess both Healthy School Recognized Campus (HSRC) and the mentoring program.
criteria:
School Inclusion Criteria:

* located in Central and East Texas
* Public school

Student Inclusion Criteria

* enrolled in the 4th, 5th, 6th, 7th, 8th, or 9th grade
* able to read, speak, and write in English

Student Exclusion Criteria:

* any motor or cognitive impairments or other health conditions that would prevent them from completing a physical assessment
